football_evidence.question: Can Charlotte’s pass rush get to Ryder Burton?
football_evidence.assessment: Some measured evidence supports EdgeDesk’s lean toward UAB, and its own breakdown accounts for about 0.8 of the 4.3 points, but not the full gap. It is a research question, not a bet.
supporting: When Charlotte has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Charlotte’s offense has allowed a sack on 6.3% of its dropbacks, and UAB’s defense sacks the quarterback on 7.7% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.7%).

When Charlotte has the ball (big plays through the air): Charlotte’s offense turns 9.0% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and UAB’s defense gives up explosive gains on 4.2% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.2%).
When UAB has the ball (third down): UAB’s offense converts 43.5% of its third downs, and Charlotte’s defense allows opponents to convert 50.9% of their third downs (FBS average 39.6%).

When Charlotte has the ball (the passing game against the pass defense): Charlotte’s offense averages 7.4 yards per pass attempt, and UAB’s defense allows 5.7 yards per pass attempt (FBS average 7.4).
contradicting: When UAB has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): UAB’s offense has allowed a sack on 11.1% of its dropbacks, and Charlotte’s defense sacks the quarterback on 4.6% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.7%).
When UAB has the ball (the red zone): UAB’s offense succeeds on 31.1% of its red-zone plays, and Charlotte’s defense allows success on 48.2% of opponent red-zone plays (FBS average 43.5%).
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Charlotte’s quarterback room No. 92 nationally and UAB’s No. 121.
quarterbacks: Ryder Burton has completed 104 of 194 passes (53.6%) for 1,343 yards, 6.9 yards per attempt, 6 touchdowns and 5 interceptions in eight games for UAB, and has been sacked on 25 of 219 dropbacks.
Cole Gonzales has completed 77 of 125 passes (61.6%) for 863 yards, 6.9 yards per attempt, 3 touchdowns and 7 interceptions in five games for Charlotte, and has been sacked on 5 of 130 dropbacks.
Conner Harrell has completed 74 of 108 passes (68.5%) for 831 yards, 7.7 yards per attempt, 5 touchdowns and 2 interceptions in five games for Charlotte, and has been sacked on 8 of 116 dropbacks.
